purpose: Root index of all Education hubs and root-level articles.
owns: Navigation to hubs; Education's overall scope statement.
does_not_own: Any keyword cluster; commercial head terms.
relationship_to_commercial: Links to category hubs where a reader is ready to shop.
relationship_to_blog_faq_tools: Blog hub is a separate system (Stage 12 D-10).

purpose: Hub landing page that is also the broad definitional resource for its topic.
owns: The broad 'what is X' need of the hub plus navigation to children.
does_not_own: Narrow child needs that have their own resource.
when_to_use: When the hub's broad question has demand and no child page already owns it.
when_not_to_use: When the hub's topics are dissimilar (use an index).
relationship_to_commercial: Links to the matching commercial hub or category.
relationship_to_blog_faq_tools: FAQ answers link here for depth.
examples_in_stage14: EDU-LG-00, EDU-NAT-00, EDU-4C-00, EDU-SHP-00, EDU-CERT-00, EDU-MET-00, EDU-GEM-00
evidence: Avoids a thin hub plus an overview article competing for the same queries (Stage 11 one-need-one-resource).

purpose: Navigation-only hub for dissimilar practical topics.
when_to_use: Only when no single topic can represent the hub.
when_not_to_use: While fewer than two child guides exist (Stage 12 D-13).

purpose: Evergreen explainer for one stable question.
relationship_to_blog_faq_tools: Blog links in for evergreen explanation.

owns: One grade and its adjacent comparisons.
when_to_use: Only where a validated SERP shows grade-specific pages distinct from the scale page.
relationship_to_commercial: Links to products filtered by that grade only if such pages are indexable (Stage 12 gate).
examples_in_stage14: EDU-4C-02 SI, EDU-4C-03 VVS; EDU-4C-04 VS conditional
evidence: Stage 8: SI2 and VVS SERPs share 0 to 1 URLs with the clarity-scale SERP.

purpose: X vs Y decision content inside the hub it belongs to.
when_to_use: A validated COMPARISON or editorial SERP for the pair.
when_not_to_use: Pairs without evidence; pairs Google serves on another page.
relationship_to_commercial: Bridges to the category for the chosen option.

purpose: Decision support for choosing within one subject; distributed across hubs, not its own hub.
owns: How to choose / is it worth it for one subject.
when_to_use: One guide per distinct buyer decision (Stage 13).
when_not_to_use: A generic guide duplicating topic hubs.
relationship_to_commercial: Primary bridge from Education into categories and products.
evidence: Stage 13 framework row 13; H-BUY MERGE decision.

relationship_to_commercial: Product pages show the certificate; the guide explains it.
relationship_to_blog_faq_tools: FAQ states HOD's certificate policy and links here.

when_to_use: Shapes pillar; per-shape only if the SERP is education-led.
relationship_to_commercial: Links to shape filter states / PDPs (Stage 16).

purpose: How-to guidance for owning or buying jewellery.
when_to_use: Utility topics with a stable answer.
relationship_to_commercial: Links to products at the point of need.

when_to_use: Embedded in its guide by default; separate only if tool pages dominate the SERP.
when_not_to_use: Tools without a user need or SERP support.
relationship_to_commercial: Tool result links to category/product (e.g. size selection).

purpose: A concept covered inside a resource, with no page of its own.
when_to_use: Subordinate concepts and clusters without evidence for a page.
examples_in_stage14: CVD, HPHT, asscher, radiant, rhodium (interim), VS (interim)
evidence: Stage 11: a cluster is not a page.

purpose: Price/carat calculators, shape or style quizzes.
when_to_use: Only with measured demand and a clear business case.
when_not_to_use: No keyword in the master database supports one.

when_to_use: Only if SERP evidence shows glossary pages win term queries.
evidence: CL-003/CL-084 terminology is served in the pillar or excluded.

owns: HOD policies (shipping, returns, resizing, certificates supplied).
relationship_to_blog_faq_tools: Links to the Education owner of each topic (Stage 12 D-18).
